gen-gf-phudu-gf-kosugi: Distinctive at a glance: Phudu draws every curve with a generous opening and a ballpoint's plain line. Kosugi bends its letters like wire, with an open-jawed c, so paragraphs glide along.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-libre-franklin: A ballpoint's plain, pressure-free line runs through every Phudu letter, with generous openings on each curve. Libre Franklin, with its splayed c terminal, gives that loudness somewhere to rest.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-lunasima: Lunasima is clean and contemporary, its c tips never creeping toward touching. Beneath Phudu's bold, distinctive heading, that spacing keeps paragraphs easy to follow, line after line, without crowding.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-m-plus-1p: Phudu holds a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight. M PLUS 1p stays clean beneath it, with openness at every curve end that keeps the text moving.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Generous openings on every curve and a ballpoint's pressure-free line give Phudu its bold, distinctive character. M PLUS Code Latin glows like neon tubing beside it, approachable and clean.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Phudu's diagonals carry the same heft as its verticals, giving the heading a bold, distinctive presence. And M PLUS Rounded 1c stays approachable below it, its terminals stopping short of curling back in.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-manjari: Manjari brings approachable text, its curves ending in wide, unclosed terminals and drawn with a steady, unvarying line weight. Its main quality is distinctiveness: Phudu's bold heading above Manjari's steady line.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-meera-inimai: Phudu opens every curve generously and draws with a ballpoint's pressure-free line, so its bold heading feels instantly distinctive. Meera Inimai supplies the room: open curves with a blueprint's constant line.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-metrophobic: Bold from the first letter, Phudu draws strokes like a wire. Metrophobic, modern and clean, gives each bend a smooth, unobstructed path, so the text stays easy to move through.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-mona-sans: Loud and distinctive, Phudu keeps a single unit-width stroke in every letter. Mona Sans, neutral and professional, leaves letter openings as wide as a door left ajar, so text reads without strain.
